integrity: The polynomial checker validates algebraic identities; it is not an independent certificate of general elliptic-surface theorems. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: The full rank-four lattice is asserted only over the universal generic coefficient field, not for every fixed hyperelliptic member or after algebraic closure of the coefficient field. The four sections remain independent in all admissible complex specializations. The rational-source D4* classification is classical. An unindexed published derivation of the same combined generic statement remains possible.
title: Exact generic Mordell–Weil lattice in a hyperelliptic elliptic-surface family
